title: Findings and pitfalls
summary: ooRexx: P7 call x~y is a syntax error (made five times; run_tests.sh refuses to run while it is present). P8 /proc files report size 0, so lines() says 0. P9 a variable named RESULT is overwritten by the next message instruction (made twice; pre-check too). MutableBuffer~append(a, b) joins without spaces. A guarded method that loops holds the object lock (fixed: plan/watch loops unguarded). The security manager does not see .File/.Stream or value(..., ENVIRONMENT). API traps the live LLM found: empty results looked unreadable; insertStep shifted positions; exitIs on a non-program; outputHas only on programs; no fileAbsent; continue-after-fail reported PASSED. A killed make orphan (sleep 3) held the output pipe 1.8 s.
authority: built and tested (architecture Tom Dyer; coding and writing Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-24)
invariants: In an LLM-first shell the live LLM is the usability test
procedure: Run the live chain after any change to the job objects
